description: Retrieval benchmark: questions that describe a problem without naming the SWEBOK technique. Each question lists evidence phrases copied from the SWEBOK v4 text; build_qrels.py turns them into the expected leaves (every leaf under swebok-v4/root that contains an evidence phrase). Review the questions and the evidence, not the computed leaves. v2 (19/11/2026): the 12 original questions with a reviewed gold standard, plus one question per SWEBOK knowledge area the original set did not cover (N01-N13).
answer_format: Answer with a list of guidelines. After each guideline, cite the source it comes from: the path of the SWEBOK file if you have it, otherwise a verbatim quote of at least 8 words from the passage, in the form (source: ...).
